lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 14 distinct, high-contrast vertical white lines traversing the lateral torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the central torso, with increased density and shorter segment lengths appearing at the posterior and anterior margins of the flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible on the 13th line (counting from posterior to anterior) near the dorsal-lateral ridge. Minor bifurcations or line-merges are also present at the dorsal terminus of lines 11 and 12.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first posterior line is an abbreviated vertical segment that does not reach the dorsal ridge. Multiple dashed or fragmented horizontal segments are visible along the lower ventral boundary of the torso mass, separate from the primary vertical lines.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 6-7 high-contrast white spots is located on the posterior-lateral haunch, positioned superior to the hind limb joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: A grouping of three spots on the lower mid-flank forms a semi-connected horizontal geometric line.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white facial markings including a transverse chevron between the orbits, a singular high-contrast circular spot on the lower cheek, and a prominent white patch on the lower ventral neck area.
